generated_by: manual selection: fdb_v3 tools fixed + greedy fractional set-cover over VAB+W2C collected records, curated for redundancy/fit
selection_method: 12 fdb_v3 tools kept unconditionally (every tool fdb_v3's 79 real recordings actually use). Remaining 18 slots chosen by greedy weighted set-cover over the 490 VAB+When2Call records already collected in data/ + data/text-only/: at each step, the tool that would fully unlock the most currently-uncovered records (fractional credit while a record still needs >1 tool) was added. Two greedy picks were manually rejected afterward: get_current_weather (redundant with get_weather -- merged instead) and Media_3_FindMovies/cmd_controller.execute (excluded -- see notes).

tools.name: location_get_coordinates
tools.reason: Address-to-coordinates resolver; the anchor dependency for almost every ride-hailing chain (trip_estimate_cost, vehicle_check_availability, trip_confirm_booking all take its output) -- highest-frequency tool in the whole corpus (104 occurrences) and core to implicit-argument and sequential_tool_call testing.

tools.name: get_weather
tools.reason: Highest-value merge: near-zero-arg lookup that recurs constantly across When2Call's call_or_not/missing_argument menus -- single biggest unlock for text-only coverage.

tools.name: get_stock_price
tools.reason: 4 args, finance domain, recurs across multiple When2Call templates. Required set narrowed to company_name+date: the original all-4-required schema forced an unrealistic single utterance stating symbol, exchange, company_name, and date at once; symbol/exchange are now optional refinements.

tools.reason: Pairs with book_appointment for sequential search-then-book support.

tools.name: events_3_find_events

tools.name: hotels_2_search_house
tools.reason: Vacation-rental search; recurs across When2Call travel-domain menus (10 occurrences). Added a required guests arg (2025 audit) so its schema is no longer identical to hotels_4_search_hotel -- previously both were location/check_in/check_out with nothing to actually distinguish them structurally.

tools.name: hotels_4_search_hotel
tools.reason: Distinct hotel-chain search (different from Hotels_2's vacation-rental framing); high recurrence. Added an optional star_rating arg (2025 audit) as the structural counterpart to hotels_2_search_house's guests arg, giving the pair a real argument-level distinction instead of only a naming difference.

tools.name: homes_2_find_home_by_area
tools.reason: Real-estate purchase search -- distinct from fdb_v3's search_apartments (buy vs. rent), adds housing-domain variety. Extended from a single area arg to area+max_price (required) plus bedrooms/property_type (optional) (2025 audit): the original single-arg schema offered almost no argument-binding or correction surface.

tools.name: get_current_location
tools.reason: Zero-arg implicit-context resolver for 'near me'/'my current address' references; the model must recognize the value cannot be resolved from the utterance alone and issue this call before the target tool, then bind its output via <result:0.FIELD> -- core to voice-specific implicit-argument testing (resolvable_implicit_argument).

tools.name: get_current_date
tools.reason: Zero-arg implicit-context resolver for relative-date references ('today', 'in three days') that need an absolute date computed, as opposed to relative dates preserved as spoken via normalization -- distinguishes true resolver-call cases from plain normalization within resolvable_implicit_argument.

tools.name: get_current_time
tools.reason: Zero-arg implicit-context resolver for relative-time references ('right now', 'in an hour') needing an absolute time, mirroring get_current_date for the time-of-day case.

tools.name: get_user_profile
tools.reason: Zero-arg implicit-context resolver for possessive references to the user's own saved data ('my usual card', 'my saved address') -- the one resolver in the pool covering identity/preference fields rather than spatiotemporal context.

considered_and_rejected.name: get_current_weather
considered_and_rejected.reason: Redundant with get_weather (same real-world action, When2Call naming variant) -- merged instead of kept as a separate slot.

considered_and_rejected.name: Media_3_FindMovies
considered_and_rejected.reason: Misleading name in the source data itself -- every occurrence pairs it with music tools (Music_3_PlayMedia) for song/lyrics queries, never an actual movie search. Confusable, excluded.

considered_and_rejected.name: cmd_controller.execute
considered_and_rejected.reason: Generic OS-command executor ("shut down the browser") with an unconstrained free-text command argument -- doesn't fit the domain-action shape (search/book/get) the rest of the pool shares, and doesn't naturally support argument-binding or confusability testing.
